combo_label: The Village Fete × Sewing & Knitting × Magna Carta

entries.clue: Dry winter feed for the cattle, got in and stacked before the tents go up
Downy, fluffy wool from a long-haired rabbit, notorious for shedding
Fixed yearly rent of a shire, which clause 25 forbade sheriffs to raise.
Stranded colourwork knitting named after a lonely island with a famous bird observatory
To trade for money, which clause 40 promised the king would never do with justice.
Small round seeds in a pod, set out by the dish for the vegetable classes
Ball of snipped wool ends, wound on two card rings, that tops a bobble hat
Half a dozen from the nest boxes, matched for shade and size
Domed monument raised at the 1215 meadow by American lawyers in 1957.
Cream sweater of cables and bobbles named after islands at the mouth of Galway Bay
Trestle of donated paperbacks and old hardbacks, ten pence each
Papal letter hung with a lead pendant; John got one in 1215 to quash his charter.
